name: Paradoxe Instable
description: Manifestation d'une réalité parallèle, Paradoxe Instable émane de la Faille Dimensionnelle. Son existence même crée des distorsions spatio-temporelles, rendant les attaques ennemies imprévisibles et disjointes.

loadout.armor_outfit: Shattered reality plates held together by glitched void energy, floating debris fragments, tattered cloth that hovers in zero‑gravity pockets, corrupted armor pieces pulsing with deep violet light
loadout.arsenal: Twin‑palm nullification beam – a concentrated violet‑magenta energy lance that locks onto high‑value targets; reality‑warping gauntlets that bend space around the wielder

attitude.behavior: Leaping forward, both hands thrust out, channeling a searing violet nullification beam, body mid‑air with glitch distortion rippling around limbs, swirling debris orbiting the figure
attitude.emotion: Intense, psychotic focus; eyes revulsed in a mix of terror and ecstatic rapture, a grimace of unhinged determination

palette_names.name: Deep Violet
palette_names.role: Primary energy accent – 10% of the image

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Glitching neon violet and magenta light sources, harsh black shadows, pulsating energy beams, chromatic aberration, cinematic rim lighting

camera.angle: Low angle with a slight Dutch tilt to enhance disorientation

scenography.setting: Reality collapse zone – overlapping parallel versions of a ruined cityscape: buildings simultaneously intact and destroyed, fractured ground revealing layered battlefields, impossible sky displaying contradictory celestial bodies, gravity inversions causing debris to fall upward and sideways
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Reality‑glitch effect, chromatic aberration, swirling violet‑magenta vortexes, floating debris, cracks in space that shimmer like broken glass, subtle gravitational distortions, pulsing neon auras around the combatant
